newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 5.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 6 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov, in an interview with the paper, again denies rumours of disagreements between the prime minister and his first deputies.
- The U.S. space agency NASA threatens to stop sending American astronaunts to the Russian Mir space station.
- A number of economic measures taken recently by the Russian president and government signify that the second stage of reforms has started in Russia.
- Russia's coal industry is facing great changes.
- Russia's Sberbank, the state savings bank, is playing increasingly active role in servicing the federal budget.
- Tightening of tax regulations in the oil industry has had a negative impact on the activity of joint ventures.
